scripts.build: npm run build:pyodide && npm run build:skills && npm run build -w @galaxyproject/olit
scripts.dev: npm run build && npm run dev -w @galaxyproject/olit
scripts.lint:scripts: python3 -m black --check --line-length 120 scripts && ruff check --line-length 120 scripts

scripts.build:session: npm run build:pyodide && npm run build:skills && npm run build:session -w @galaxyproject/olit
